Titles.eng: Mister Ajikko
Titles.jpn: ミスター味っ子

Summaries.eng: Ajiyoshi Yoichi is a culinary prodigy who manages the eating house together with his mother. One day, Murata Genjiro appears in the eating house and is surprised at the delicious taste and delicate culinary skills of the katsu-don prepared by Youichi. Subsequently, Youichi is being invited to the Aji-oh Building in which he is involved in a spaghetti match with the in-house Italian chef, Marui. Youichi's novel culinary ideas, coupled with his enthusiasm of serving the best for his guests, allow him to defeat Marui in the match. From then on, Youichi begins to compete with other rivals in the race for the best tastes and dishes.
Summaries.jpn: 東京の下町にある日之出食堂で、亡き父の跡を継ぎ厨房に立つ少年・味吉陽一。ある日、“味皇”こと日本料理人会の長・村田源二郎が現れ、陽一のカツ丼の美味さに衝撃を受ける。以来、陽一は料理界に知られることとなり、様々な料理人が彼に勝負を挑んでくる。

Titles.eng: Born to Cook Special
Titles.jpn: 味将軍七包丁人だよ!全員集合

Summaries.jpn: 味将軍グループの城中で、味将軍とマネージャー・毛利が、それまで登場した「味将軍七包丁」5名（カモン・武智・大虎・関場・ロボコック）の行動を拝見する総集編で、最後には残りの2名の大石老師（&瀬戸内少年料理団）と阿部一郎を紹介する。第68話「アレックス急行グルメ事件! デザートでゴールを目指せ」と合わせて、19:00 - 19:55の枠で『ミスター味っ子 ワイド版』と銘打って放送された。

Titles.eng: The Culinary Prodigy, Ajiyoshi Youichi
Titles.jpn: 天才料理人・味吉陽一登場

Summaries.eng: Hinode Shokudo is a restaurant located in downtown Tokyo. Yoichi Ajiyoshi, who inherited his late father's business, returns home to his house after school to find a line of customers waiting for him.
Summaries.jpn: 東京の下町にある日之出食堂。亡き父の跡を継いでのれんを守る味吉陽一は、今日も学校が終わるや、客が待ち並ぶ我が家へ帰って来た。そこへ日本料理人会の首領“味皇”こと、村田源二郎が現れ…。

Titles.eng: A Spaghetti Match
Titles.jpn: スパゲティで勝負だ

Summaries.eng: Yoichi, who was invited by Murata to visit the Ajioh Building, ends up being challenged by Chef Marui, head of the Italian cuisine department at the Ajioh Culinary Association. The competition is set for one week, and the dish being competed is Marui's specialty, spaghetti with meat sauce. Yoichi is fired up to compete, impressed by the deliciousness of Marui's spaghetti.
Summaries.jpn: 村田から招待を受け味皇ビルを訪ねた陽一は、味皇料理会イタリア料理部主任・丸井シェフの挑戦を受けることに。勝負は1週間後、競う料理はミートソース・スパゲティ。ファイトを燃やす陽一だったが…。

Titles.eng: A Duel with Chef Marui
Titles.jpn: 丸井シェフとの決戦

Summaries.eng: Yoichi discovers that eggplant is the vegetable that pairs best with meat sauce, but he quickly hits another obstacle.
Summaries.jpn: ミートソースに合う野菜がナスであることを見つけた陽一だが、早くも次の壁にぶつかってしまう。風味を出すためにナスの量を増やすほど、ナスの水気でソースが水っぽくなってしまうのだ。悩む陽一だったが…。

Titles.eng: The Curry Genius, Sakai Kazuma
Titles.jpn: カレーの天才・堺一馬

Summaries.eng: Land grabbers have come to Hinode Shokudo to demand eviction. The landlord, Nagata, plans to demolish the entire area and build an ultra-luxurious restaurant building. Yoichi goes alone to protest, where he comes face to face with Nagata's personal genius young chef, Sakai Kazuma. With the diner's eviction at stake, they decide to compete using Kazuma's specialty chicken curry!
Summaries.jpn: 地上げ屋が立ち退きを迫って日之出食堂にやって来た。地主の永田は一帯を取り壊して超豪華なレストランビルを建てるつもりだった。単身抗議に行った陽一は、そこで永田お抱えの天才少年料理人・堺一馬と対峙する。

Titles.eng: Special Pineapple Curry
Titles.jpn: 必殺パイナップル・カレー

Summaries.eng: Yoichi's special curry is being prepared at a rapid pace. He uses rice with carrots, spices, mustard, and a roux with a hint of coffee as a secret ingredient, and finally comes up with a secret plan to tenderize the tough gamecock meat. On the day of the showdown, Yoichi challenges Sakai Kazuma's curry with a curry made using a certain container!
Summaries.jpn: 陽一特製のカレー作りが急ピッチで進んでいた。ニンジンを入れたライス、香辛料にマスタード、コーヒーを隠し味にしたルー。そしてついに硬い軍鶏の肉を柔らかくする秘策を思いついた陽一は、決戦の日を迎える。

Titles.eng: Secret Taste · the Ramen Match
Titles.jpn: 秘伝の味・ラーメン勝負

Summaries.eng: Nakada, the ace of the baseball team, skips practice to help out at his family's ramen shop. When Yoichi visits "Chinese Nakada," he learns that the shop is in danger of losing customers to a new ramen shop called "Kouraiken" that has opened nearby. Yoichi volunteers to help out at the town's ramen festival, but is overwhelmed by the deliciousness of Koraiken's ramen.
Summaries.jpn: 野球部のエース・仲田が家のラーメン屋を手伝うために練習を休んだ。陽一が中華なかだを訪ねると、近所にオープンした甲来軒の影響で店の危機だという。町内ラーメン祭りで勝負だと、陽一は助っ人を買って出るが…。

Titles.eng: Heated fight · Ramen Festival
Titles.jpn: 熱闘・ラーメン祭り

Summaries.eng: The day of the town's ramen festival has arrived. Kumagoro Ramen, Tamagawa Hanten, Koraiken, and Yoichi, along with the Chinese restaurant Nakada, compete for the best flavor. Yoichi's ramen is made with a greasy soup full of pork bones, and it doesn't seem like anything edible. However, Yoichi comes up with one secret plan after another. What will be the outcome of the judging?
Summaries.jpn: 町内ラーメン祭りの日。熊五郎ラーメン、玉川飯店、甲来軒、そして陽一が助っ人の中華なかだが味を競う。陽一の作るラーメンは豚骨たっぷりのギトギトスープで、とても食べられる代物には見えず…。

Titles.eng: The Secret of the Tender Steak
Titles.jpn: 柔らかステーキの秘密

Summaries.eng: Yoichi is tempted by the prize of a year's supply of beef, and enters a steak contest using imported beef.
Summaries.jpn: 優勝賞品が牛肉1年分と聞いて、輸入牛肉のステーキコンテストに参加する陽一。かつて味皇料理会に所属していた肉料理の天才・小西和也の姿もあり、負けたくないと思う陽一だったが輸入牛肉の硬さに驚かされる。

Titles.eng: Conclusion of the Steak Contest
Titles.jpn: 決着ステーキ・コンテスト

Summaries.eng: The match between Yoichi and Konishi is evenly matched, and the outcome is about to be decided by the most important thing: how to grill the meat.
Summaries.jpn: ステーキに冷たい大根おろしソースを掛けるための、いつまでも冷めない特別な皿を用意してコンテストに挑む陽一。五分に渡り合う陽一と小西の戦いは、最も重要な肉の焼き方で勝負が決まろうとしていた。

Titles.eng: The Sardine Gratin is the Taste of Mother's Cooking
Titles.jpn: いわしグラタンは母の味

Summaries.eng: Yoichi's classmate Takeshi's mother is Yoko Egawa, a familiar cooking expert who appears on TV. However, the meals the Egawa family makes for Yoko, who is busy, are not tasty. Yoichi invites Takeshi to Hinode Shokudo to try some delicious food, but Yoko shows up. So they decide to have a taste contest with sardine gratin!
Summaries.jpn: 陽一の同級生・たけしの母はテレビでもお馴染みの料理研究家・江川洋子。しかし、多忙な陽子に代わってお手伝いさんの作る食事は美味しくないようで、陽一は彼に美味しい料理を食べさせようと日之出食堂に招待する。

Titles.eng: Challenge from Aji Shogun
Titles.jpn: 味将軍からの挑戦状

Summaries.eng: The Aji Shogun Group, which shares power with the Ajio Cooking Association in the Japanese Culinary Association, aims to gain control of restaurants across the country. Aiming to take on the long-established Western restaurant Traumerei, Aji Shogun sends in Chef Abe, the core of the group. Yoichi steps up to help Traumerei and challenges Abe's hamburger steak dish head-on.
Summaries.jpn: 日本の料理界を二分する味皇料理会と味将軍グループ。全国の料理店を支配下に置くことを狙う味将軍は老舗の洋食店・トロイメライを潰そうと画策。そんなトロイメライを救おうと陽一はハンバーグで真っ向勝負を挑む。

Titles.eng: The Ultimate Kebab Hamburger
Titles.jpn: 究極の串焼きハンバーグ

Summaries.eng: Chef Abe's new hamburger steak is a wonderfully tender dish, cooked to perfection by wrapping the meat in wax paper and placing it in the oven to prevent the juices from escaping. Yoichi, on the other hand, comes up with a unique way to prevent the juices from escaping when grilling skewered hamburger steaks, which are skewered and grilled on a charcoal grill. Finally, the day of the competition arrives, and the winner is decided by the number of regular customers!
Summaries.jpn: 味将軍グループのシェフ・阿部の新しいハンバーグに対して、陽一は肉汁を逃がさないための工夫を施して七輪で焼く串焼きハンバーグを考案。一般客の数で判定が行われる勝負の日がいよいよ訪れる。

Titles.eng: Japan's Best Okonomiyaki Competition
Titles.jpn: 日本一お好み焼き勝負

Summaries.eng: Yoichi and his friends go to a shrine for their first visit of the year. Learning that Hinode Shokudo also set up a stall at the New Year's festival when his father was alive, Yoichi goes to apply to set up a stall, but it is already booked up. Yoichi protests against Okadaya, an okonomiyaki restaurant that is using its popularity to force its way into the space of two other restaurants. They decide to have an okonomiyaki competition with the right to set up a stall at stake!
Summaries.jpn: 初詣で神社を訪れた陽一は、父の代に日之出食堂も新年祭に出店を出していたことを知る。そこで自分も出店しようとするがすでにスペースは埋まっていた。しかし、あるお好み焼き屋が2店分のスペースを取っていて…。

Titles.eng: Okonomiyaki Competition: The Judges Are Also Your Enemy
Titles.jpn: お好み焼き勝負・審査員も敵だ

Summaries.eng: The deep richness of the sauce, which has been aged for six months, is impossible for even an Ajikko to surpass in such a short time. He has even bribed the judges to ensure perfection. Just as Okadaya had planned, Yoichi is stumped by how to make the sauce, but he comes up with a clever idea to create a richer flavor.
Summaries.jpn: 半年間熟成させたソースを武器にする岡田屋とのお好み焼き勝負。岡田屋の思惑通りソース作りに頭を抱える陽一は、深いコクのあるソースを作るアイデアを思いつく。一方、岡田屋は審査員に買収を仕掛けており…。

Titles.eng: Ajikko Struggles In the Ekiben Showdown
Titles.jpn: 味っ子苦戦・駅弁対決

Summaries.eng: The owner of Kikuchiya, an Aomori station bento shop where Yoichi's father helped season the bento during his national training period, has come to Tokyo. He laments that he will have no choice but to close the shop if things continue as they are, due to the popularity of Oikawa, a new station bento shop that has opened on the same platform. Not wanting to lose his father's memorable bento, Yoichi takes on the challenge of making a makunouchi bento that surpasses Oikawa's.
Summaries.jpn: 陽一の父が全国修業時代に味付けを手伝った青森の駅弁屋“菊地屋”の主人が上京してきた。ところが、駅の同じホームに開店した駅弁屋“及川”の人気に、このままでは店を畳むしかないと嘆き…。

Titles.eng: Magical Piping Hot Makunouchi Bento
Titles.jpn: 魔法のあつあつ幕の内弁当

Summaries.eng: Following Kazuma's advice, Yoichi makes it possible to eat warm grilled salmon wrapped in foil at any time. However, Kazuma's words bothered Yoichi, and when he arrived in Aomori, he felt the cold of the northern region and quickly remade the lunch box. Now it's time for a challenge! Can Oikawa, who has become famous in the media, attract a flock of customers?
Summaries.jpn: 一馬がくれたヒントから、いつでも温かく鮭のホイル焼きを食べられるようにした陽一。ところが、一馬の言葉が気になっていた陽一は、乗り込んだ青森で北国の寒さを肌身に感じ、急いで弁当箱を作り変える。

Titles.eng: The Tempura Showdown: Giant Kakiage Bowl
Titles.jpn: 特大カキアゲで天丼勝負

Summaries.eng: Yoichi goes to the long-established Tensei restaurant to eat tempura bowls and is surprised by the delicious taste. There, he sees an employee named Kotaro spilling tea on a customer and being yelled at by the old-fashioned owner that he's being fired. Yoichi impulsively steps in and confronts the owner. To get Kotaro's dismissal overturned, he must make a tempura bowl that surpasses Tensei's!
Summaries.jpn: 老舗の“天星”に天丼を食べに行き、その素晴らしい味に驚く陽一。そこで客にお茶をこぼした従業員・高太郎が、昔気質の主人からクビだと怒鳴られたのを見た陽一は、思わず中に割って入り主人と対峙してしまう。

Titles.eng: A Great Struggle? Match of the Handmade Chocolates
Titles.jpn: 大奮戦？手作りチョコで勝負

Summaries.eng: Valentine's Day is coming up soon. Yoichi's classmates, Reiko and her friends, ask him to teach them how to make homemade chocolate. They also want to hold a chocolate contest, so they ask him to be a judge, much to Yoichi's dismay. Mitsuko, enraged by Yoichi's lovey-dovey attitude towards Reiko, also decides to enter the contest...
Summaries.jpn: もうすぐバレンタインデー。同級生のれい子たちから「手作りチョコの調理法を教えてほしい」と頼まれた陽一は、さらにチョココンテストの審査員を務めることに。コンテストにはみつ子も参加することになり…。

Titles.eng: Omelette Challenge: Defeat the Cooking Machine
Titles.jpn: オムレツ勝負・お料理マシーンを打ち破れ

Summaries.eng: Chef Satoyama of the omelet specialty restaurant "Little Egg" comes to Hinode Shokudo in a depressed mood. He says he was fired after losing a challenge to Tawara Sanshiro's all-purpose cooking machine. Enraged by Tawara's rant that "the world has no need for chefs," Yoichi challenges the all-purpose cooking machine to an omelet competition.
Summaries.jpn: オムレツ専門店“リトルエッグ”の里山シェフは、俵三四郎の万能調理マシーンとの勝負に負けて店をクビになったという。「料理人などこの世に必要ない」と吠える俵にカッとなった陽一は、マシーンとの勝負に挑む。

Titles.eng: Japanese Taste: Ochazuke Competition
Titles.jpn: 日本の味・お茶漬け勝負

Summaries.eng: Rumors spread that Ajiou is retiring because of harassment from the Ajiou shogun Group, causing  unrest within the Ajiou Culinary Society, as they wondered who Ajiou's successor would be. Ajiou has no intention of retiring, but he tells Tarume that he wants Yoichi to be his successor. Shiba Hiroyuki, head of the Japanese cuisine department, overhears this and challenges Yoichi to a challenge.
Summaries.jpn: 味皇が引退するという噂が流れた。味将軍グループによる嫌がらせだったが、味皇料理会の一部に「後継者は誰なのか」と動揺が生じる。引退する気は全くない味皇だが、陽一を後継者にとの考えを垂目に話し…。

Titles.eng: Chef Grand Prix: Fry Competition
Titles.jpn: 開催料理人グランプリ・フライで勝負

Summaries.eng: The Aji Shogun Group, intent on disrupting the Aji Kou Culinary Association and bringing down Aji Kou, spreads rumors of Aji Kou's retirement. In response, Aji Kou holds the "Aji Kou Culinary Association Chef Grand Prix" to strengthen unity within the association and encourage the chefs to work harder. Chef Marui encourages Yoichi to participate, but Yoichi, worried about his future, is hesitant.
Summaries.jpn: 味皇料理会を混乱させ、味皇の失脚を目論む味将軍グループが流した味皇引退の噂。これに対し味皇は料理会の結束を高め、料理人たちの精進を促すために「味皇料理会・料理人グランプリ」を開催する。

Titles.eng: Chef Grand Prix Final: Four Heavenly Kings Curry Battle
Titles.jpn: 料理人グランプリ決勝・四天王カレー戦

Summaries.eng: The finals of the Ajiou Cooking Competition Chef Grand Prix have finally begun. Yoichi heads to the fish market in search of the perfect ingredients for his assigned dish, seafood curry.
Summaries.jpn: いよいよ「味皇料理会・料理人グランプリ」の決勝戦が始まった。陽一は課題料理のシーフードカレーに合う具を求めて魚市場へ出掛ける。小西たちが貝、金目鯛、伊勢エビを選んだことを知った陽一は、イカを選ぶ。

Titles.eng: Clash! Super Luxurious Seafood Curry
Titles.jpn: 激突！超豪華シーフードカレー

Summaries.eng: The first round of the Ajiou Cooking Competition Chef Grand Prix finals sees the challenge of seafood curry! Konishi's shellfish curry with butter rice, Kazuma's spiny lobster curry, and Shimonaka's golden-eyed snapper coconut curry are all tough contenders. Yoichi takes his father's knife in hand and challenges himself to the grand prize with a squid curry!
Summaries.jpn: 「味皇料理会・料理人グランプリ」決勝1回戦の課題料理はシーフードカレー。小西の貝のカレー・バターライス添え、一馬の伊勢エビカレーなど強敵ぞろいの中、陽一は父の包丁を手にイカを使ったカレーで挑む。

Titles.eng: Kazuma and the Decisive Pizza Pie Competition
Titles.jpn: 一馬と決戦ピザパイ勝負

Summaries.eng: The Chef Grand Prix is ​​coming to a close, with Yoichi and Kazuma facing off in a pizza pie showdown. Kazuma is so determined to win the Grand Prix that Nagata is not afraid to help him, not only providing an assistant but also building a huge oven. Meanwhile, Yoichi is struggling to find a way to grill his pizza that will bring out the delicious flavors of both the tomatoes and cheese.
Summaries.jpn: 「味皇料理会・料理人グランプリ」もいよいよ大詰めを迎え、陽一と一馬はピザパイで対決することに。一馬の意気込みは凄まじく、助力を惜しまぬ永田は助手を用意するだけでなく、巨大なかまどを建設する。

Titles.eng: Youichi and Kazuma's Burning Passion! The Pizza Pie Duel!
Titles.jpn: 陽一・一馬の燃える情熱！ピザパイ大決戦

Summaries.eng: The day of the finals of the Ajiou Cooking Competition Chef Grand Prix has arrived. Osaka's representative is Sakai Kazuma, and Tokyo's is Ajiyoshi Yoichi. However, Yoichi has been missing for several days. Marui introduces the contestants with a prayer in his heart, but Yoichi makes it to the finals in time. This is when the pizza showdown between the two young chefs begins!
Summaries.jpn: 「味皇料理会・料理人グランプリ」優勝決定戦の日。大阪代表は一馬、東京代表は陽一。数日前から行方不明になっていた陽一だったが、優勝決定戦に間に合い、少年料理人2人のピザ対決の火蓋が切って落とされた。

Titles.eng: Here They Come! Naniwa's Donburi Brothers Compete In Osaka
Titles.jpn: 見参！浪速のどんぶり兄弟・大阪で勝負だ

Summaries.eng: Yoichi is invited by Ajio to a cherry blossom viewing party, bringing his own food. Hearing that Sakai Kazuma will also be there, he decides to join, but Kazuma is not present at the viewing party. However, Yoichi is so impressed by the deliciousness of the food that Nagata has brought for Kazuma that he decides to go to Osaka. In Osaka, Kazuma is taking on a challenge from twin young chefs known as the "Naniwa Donburi Brothers."
Summaries.jpn: 味皇から料理持参の花見に招待された陽一は、永田が持って来た一馬の料理の素晴らしさに大阪行きを決意する。大阪では一馬が「浪速のどんぶり兄弟」と呼ばれる双子の少年料理人の挑戦を受けていた。

Titles.eng: It's A Three-Legged Race! Yoichi And Kazuma's Curry Bowl
Titles.jpn: 二人三脚で勝負だ！陽一・一馬のカレーどんぶり

Summaries.eng: Yoichi offers to be Kazuma's partner as he takes on a challenge from the Naniwa Donburi Brothers, twin young chefs said to be geniuses at making rice bowls. Kazuma doesn't agree to teaming up with Yoichi, but Yoichi senses something extraordinary in the twins' intensity. Astonished by the taste of the twins' curry bowls, Yoichi begins researching curry bowls while helping out at another restaurant.
Summaries.jpn: 「浪速のどんぶり兄弟」の挑戦を受ける一馬に、相棒となることを申し出た陽一だったが、一馬に拒否される。双子のカレー丼の味にがくぜんとした陽一は、ほかの店を手伝いながらカレー丼の研究を始める。

Titles.eng: Fierce Battle! Osaka Castle Curry Bowl Spring Battle
Titles.jpn: 激闘！大阪城・カレー丼春の陣

Summaries.eng: Yoichi and Kazuma's curry bowls are in agreement: the curry will be made with Kazuma's golden mixture, and the thickness will be made with Yoichi's scallion and grated yam. However, the combination doesn't work, and the two have difficulty making the curry bowl. Worried that they will lose if they continue like this, Nagata tries to get them to open up to each other by leaving them alone, but...
Summaries.jpn: 陽一と一馬のカレー丼は、カレーは一馬の黄金配合、とろみは陽一の芽かぶとろろを使うことで一致する。しかし、コンビネーションが合わない彼らを案じた永田は、2人だけにして互いの心を開かせようとするが…。

Titles.eng: A Formidable Opponent! Mr. Nabeko Appears
Titles.jpn: 強敵！ミスター鍋っ子登場

Summaries.eng: Yoichi heads to Hakata to visit Nakae Hyouta, a talented young chef and vegetable grower who has impressed Ajiou. Impressed by Hyouta's amazing vegetable dishes, Yoichi asks him to share some of his vegetables. Hyouta's condition is that he wants to see whether he is a chef who can truly make the most of his vegetables.
Summaries.jpn: 味皇を唸らせた野菜作りの天才で凄腕の少年料理人・中江兵太を訪ねるため、陽一は博多に向かう。兵太の野菜を使った料理に感激した陽一は、野菜を分けてほしいと頼む。すると、兵太は陽一にある条件を出す。

Titles.eng: Taste Test! Ajikko vs. Mr. Nabekko
Titles.jpn: 味試し！味っ子対ミスター鍋っ子

Summaries.eng: Yoichi decides to compete in a hot pot competition to get some vegetables from Nakae Heita, a boy who is a vegetable growing genius. Yoichi tries his best to come up with a solution, but when it comes to vegetables, it seems he will never be able to beat Heita's homemade one.
Summaries.jpn: 野菜作りの天才少年・中江兵太の野菜を分けてもらうため、陽一は鍋物で勝負することに。兵太の鍋は、まさに神秘的な素晴らしさ。それに対して工夫をこらす陽一だが、野菜だけは兵太の物に勝てそうになかった。

Titles.eng: Conveyor Belt Sushi Battle! Protect the Noren Flavor
Titles.jpn: 回転寿司勝負！のれんの味を守り抜け

Summaries.eng: Yoichi and Ajiou reunite with Konishi Kazuya at Hatsune Sushi, a long-established restaurant in Hakata. Konishi, who had abandoned his career as a meat chef, has been training hard there. Just then, Mouri from the Ajishogun Group appears and demands that Hatsune's master sell the restaurant or give Konishi back. In order to protect Hatsune's taste, Yoichi offers to team up with Konishi and take on the challenge.
Summaries.jpn: 陽一と味皇は博多の老舗・初音寿司で小西和也と再会する。肉料理の道を捨てた小西は、ここで新たな修行に励んでいた。そこへ味将軍グループの毛利が現れ、初音の親方に店を売るか、さもなくば小西を返せと迫る。

Titles.eng: Conveyor Belt Sushi Battle! Defeat Ajishogun
Titles.jpn: 回転寿司勝負！味将軍をうちやぶれ

Summaries.eng: In an effort to protect the taste of the long-established Hatsune Sushi restaurant, Yoichi and Konishi take on a conveyor-belt sushi competition set up by Mouri of the Ajishogun Group. Yoichi begins by making the rice under Konishi's guidance, but things don't go as planned. Konishi treats Yoichi like a child and tries to do it on his own, but Yoichi himself is desperately trying to think of ways to improve the situation.
Summaries.jpn: 味将軍グループの毛利が仕掛けた回転寿司勝負を陽一と小西は受けて立つ。小西の指導でシャリを握ることから始めた陽一だが、思うように進まない。小西は一人で何とかしようとするが、陽一も必死に工夫を考えていた。

Titles.eng: Bento Wars! Hinode Shokudo Is In danger!
Titles.jpn: 弁当ウォーズ！日之出食堂が危ない！

Summaries.eng: A bento shop called "The Oikawa" has appeared in front of Hinode Shokudo. Abe, who lost the hamburger steak contest, and Oikawa, who lost the ekiben competition, have come to try their luck at the challenge of Taste Shogun in an attempt to make a comeback. This year, The Oikawa will be taking on the role of making the bento boxes that Hinode Shokudo usually makes for the town karaoke competition.
Summaries.jpn: 日之出食堂の前に弁当屋、ザ・おいかわが出店。以前勝負に敗れた阿部と及川が、味将軍の命を受けて挑戦してきたのだ。例年、日之出食堂が作る町内カラオケ大会用の弁当を、今年はザ・おいかわが引き受けるという。

Titles.eng: The Bento Wars! The Downtown Taste is Father's Taste
Titles.jpn: 弁当ウォーズ！下町の味は父の味

Summaries.eng: In order to protect the bento boxes that are the root of Hinode Shokudo's development, Noriko and Yoichi challenge The Oikawa to a bento competition. However, the two disagree on the side dishes and start preparing separately.
Summaries.jpn: 日之出食堂発展のルーツである弁当を守るため、ザ・おいかわに弁当勝負を挑んだ典子と陽一。しかし、おかずで意見の合わない二人は別々に準備を始める。陽一はおこぜの唐揚げを思いつくが、その先が進まず…。

Titles.eng: A Challenge From Abroad! Vienna Boys' Chefs
Titles.jpn: 外国からの挑戦状！ウィーン少年料理団

Summaries.eng: Shimonaka, who had disappeared after losing the chef grand prix, returns to Japan with the Vienna Boys' Chef Troupe. His goal is to have them compete against Yoichi and test his cooking skills. One by one, the boys unravel Yoichi's cooking techniques. Impressed by their enthusiasm, Yoichi accepts the challenge of making a dessert omelet.
Summaries.jpn: 料理人グランプリに敗れて失踪していた下仲が、ウィーン少年料理団を伴い帰国した。少年たちは次々と陽一の料理の工夫を解き明かす。彼らの熱心さに感動した陽一は、デザートオムレツ勝負を受けて立つ。

Titles.eng: The Best kids' Lunch In the World
Titles.jpn: 世界最高のお子様ランチ

Summaries.eng: Jean-Pierre de Moustaki, a leading figure in the French culinary world, comes to Hinode Shokudo after learning that his apprentices, the Vienna Boys' Chefs, lost a dessert omelet competition to Yoichi. Moustaki challenges Yoichi, who has been begging for a children's lunch from Shigeru and his friends, to a children's lunch showdown at Shigeru's birthday party!
Summaries.jpn: 弟子のウィーン少年料理団が陽一との勝負に負けたと知り、フランス料理会の重鎮、ジャン・ピエール・ド・ムスタキが日之出食堂に乗り込んできた。陽一とムスタキは、しげるの誕生会でお子様ランチ対決をすることに。

Titles.eng: Cold Chinese Noodles Contest! Yoichi In Big Trouble In Nagoya
Titles.jpn: 冷し中華勝負！陽一・名古屋で大ピンチ

Summaries.eng: Yoichi is invited to the Nagoya branch of the Ajiou Culinary Association's founding anniversary seminar, where he is challenged by a mysterious boy named Shokichi to a kishimen cold Chinese noodle competition. Japan's best swordsmith, Takizawa, also known as "The Old Knife Man," volunteers to be the judge. Shokichi challenges Yoichi to the competition in order to obtain a knife forged by Takizawa, which has been used by many famous chefs.
Summaries.jpn: 味皇料理会名古屋支部の創立記念講習会に招かれた陽一は、謎の少年・章吉にきしめん冷やし中華の勝負を挑まれた。「包丁老人」こと日本一の刀鍛冶・滝沢が審査員を申し出る。章吉が陽一に勝負を挑んだ理由とは…。

Titles.eng: A Cold Chinese Noodle Contest! A Big Turnaround In Kyoto's Capital
Titles.jpn: 冷し中華勝負！京のみやこで大逆転

Summaries.eng: Yoichi heads to Kyoto to visit the old man who makes knives, Takizawa, and sees a young girl undergoing ablutions at the Takizawa residence. She is none other than Shokichi, who has been acting like a young boy for the sake of his training. Yoichi tells Takizawa that he has also come to have a knife made for him, and once again comes into conflict with Shokichi. He then offers to make him cold Chinese noodles again.
Summaries.jpn: 包丁老人・滝沢を訪ねた陽一は、滝沢邸で斎戒沐浴する少女を見る。彼女こそ修行のため少年のように振る舞っていた章吉だった。包丁をめぐって章吉と再び対立した陽一は、再度冷やし中華を作ることを滝沢に申し出る。

Titles.eng: One Knife! Chawanmushi Competition
Titles.jpn: 包丁一本！茶碗蒸し勝負

Summaries.eng: While Yoichi is trying to think of what to do to get Takizawa to forge a knife for him, he receives a challenge from Shokichi. Takizawa will be the judge, and whoever loses the chawanmushi contest will have to give up the knife.
Summaries.jpn: 滝沢老人に包丁を打ってもらうにはどうすればよいか悩む陽一に、章吉から挑戦状が届く。滝沢を審判とし、茶碗蒸し勝負で負けたほうが包丁から手を引くという条件だ。陽一は章吉を超える茶碗蒸しを作ろうとするが…。

Titles.eng: Unadon Competition! In Search of the Golden Eel
Titles.jpn: うな丼勝負！黄金のうなぎを求めて

Summaries.eng: One day during summer vacation, a customer orders an unadon (eel bowl) that is not on the menu, and Yoichi begins his challenge to make unadon. He visits the long-established Unagihama restaurant to obtain high-quality eels, but ends up in an argument with his stubborn father, Eikichi. With the consideration of Shiba Hiroyuki, who happens to be present, Yoichi agrees to share the eel if he can make an unadon that impresses Eikichi.
Summaries.jpn: 夏休みのある日、客からメニューにないうな丼を注文された陽一は、うな丼への挑戦を始める。良質のうなぎを手に入れるために老舗の「鰻浜」を訪ねるが、頑固親父の永吉と言い争いになってしまう。

Titles.eng: Takoyaki Battle Against Aji Shogun!
Titles.jpn: タコ焼き合戦・味将軍と対決だ！

Summaries.eng: On the night of the summer festival, Yoichi and his friends reunite with Sakai Kazuma and Koorogi, who are running an octopus ball stand. Sugimoto from the Aji Shogun group bursts in with a huge trailer and starts selling octopus balls. Unable to bear the sight, Yoichi challenges Sugimoto to a octopus ball contest in an attempt to scare him away, but this plays into Sugimoto's hands.
Summaries.jpn: 夏祭りの夜、陽一たちはタコ焼き屋を出していた堺一馬とコオロギに再会する。そこへ味将軍グループの杉本が巨大トレーラーで乱入し、タコ焼きを売り始めた。陽一は杉本を追い払おうとタコ焼き勝負を挑むが…。

Titles.eng: No Questions Asked! Gyoza Competition
Titles.jpn: 問答無用！餃子で勝負

Summaries.eng: A man from China named Liang Ga Ko Te suddenly challenges Yoichi to a challenge. He says he was introduced by Yonemoto of the Ajiou Culinary Association. Yonemoto has recommended Yoichi to take his place in the "Aji Sennin Tournament," where chefs aim to become the top chefs and be recognized by the Aji Sennin. Will Yoichi be able to win the gyoza challenge against Liang Ga Ko Te and advance to the Aji Sennin Tournament?
Summaries.jpn: 中国から来た漢菜という男が突然勝負を申し込んできた。料理人の頂点を目指し味仙人に認めてもらうための「味仙人トーナメント」に、米本が自分の代わりに陽一を推薦したのだ。陽一は漢菜との餃子勝負に挑む。

Titles.eng: Rough Sea Challenge: A Challenge From A Chef of the Sea
Titles.jpn: 荒磯勝負・海の料理人からの挑戦状

Summaries.eng: Yoichi receives an invitation from Ajio to a villa on the island. However, waiting for him on the island are Ajio and his friends, who are confused because they were invited by Yoichi. Who could have orchestrated this? A man soon appears, introducing himself as Ajifune Toshiya, a chef of the sea, and challenges Yoichi to a grilled fish contest on the rough sea. What's more, he claims to be the man who once defeated Yoichi's father, Takao.
Summaries.jpn: 陽一の下に味皇から島の別荘への招待状が届くが、島で待っていたのは陽一に呼ばれたという困惑した味皇たちだった。やがて現れた男は海の張飛と名乗り、陽一に焼き魚での荒磯勝負を挑んでくる。

Titles.eng: The Seashore Match: The Secret of Yoichi-Style Stone-Grilled Fish
Titles.jpn: 荒磯勝負・陽一式石焼き魚の秘密

Summaries.eng: Yoichi challenges the chef Ajifune Toshiya, who is a chef at sea, to a wild rock battle for the blue ticket in the Taste Sennin Tournament. He begins researching grilled fish, and after much deliberation, comes up with the idea of ​​using heated stones. The day of the battle arrives. Toshiya also sets the conditions that he must grill the fish before the rocks sink into the sea, and find ingredients to make another dish.
Summaries.jpn: 味仙人トーナメントの青札を賭けて、海の料理人・張飛との荒磯勝負に挑む陽一。焼き魚の研究を始めた陽一は、熱した石を使うことを思いつく。そして勝負の日がやってくるが、張飛はさらなる条件を出してくる。

Titles.eng: Mountain Delicacies Battle! Cooking Survival With the Tough Nabeko
Titles.jpn: 山の幸勝負！強敵鍋っ子と料理サバイバル

Summaries.eng: Yoichi visits Seki Heisuke, a mountain chef who holds a green card and is the master of his father, Takao. However, Seki refuses to challenge Yoichi, telling him to talk to another chef who has challenged Seki and take the card. That chef is Mr. Nabekko, Nakae Heita. It's time for another survival cooking challenge!
Summaries.jpn: 父・隆男の師匠であり、緑札を持つ山の料理人・関羽を訪ねた陽一。しかし関羽は陽一との勝負に応じず、関羽に挑戦してきたもう1人の料理人に札を持って行けという。その料理人とはミスター鍋っ子・中江兵太だった。

Titles.eng: Mountain Delicacies Competition! A Big Win With Specially Steamed Food
Titles.jpn: 山の幸勝負！特製かまど蒸しで大勝利

Summaries.eng: As Yoichi and Hyota compete in a cooking survival game for the green card of the Taste Sennin Tournament, Kazuma appears with a yellow card. He says he will act as judge in place of the mountain chef, Seki Heisuke. However, the game is temporarily suspended due to rain. Inside the mountain hut, the three young chefs discuss their thoughts and goals.
Summaries.jpn: 味仙人トーナメントの緑札を賭けて料理サバイバル勝負を繰り広げる陽一と兵太の前に、黄札を持った一馬が現れた。一馬は山の料理人・関羽の代わりに審判をするという。だが、勝負は雨のため一時中断してしまう。

Titles.eng: The Fateful Showdown! Yoichi and Kazuma's Saury Match
Titles.jpn: 宿命の大決戦！陽一・一馬のサンマ勝負

Summaries.eng: Marui suggested that Yoichi compete against his arch rival, Kazuma, to win the yellow card by competing over a saury set meal at Hinode Shokudo. However, it was Hinode Shokudo's Appreciation Day, and the restaurant was packed. Seeing Yoichi preparing one dish after another, Kazuma also began to help out. And when all the menu items were sold out, the saury competition began!
Summaries.jpn: 宿命のライバル・一馬との黄札を賭けての勝負は、丸井の提案により日之出食堂でのサンマ定食勝負に。しかし、その日は日之出食堂の感謝デーで、店は大賑わい。次々と料理を作る陽一の姿に一馬も手伝い始める。

Titles.eng: Challenge the Taste Sennin! This Is the Trump Card to Victory
Titles.jpn: 味仙人への挑戦！勝利への切り札はこれだ

Summaries.eng: With the four cards in hand, Yoichi visits Ajiji Temple, where Ajisennin lives. Ajisennin is holding a memorial service and waiting for the food tournament winner. Yoichi is surprised to find that there is only rice in the kitchen, but he learns the meaning of preparing ingredients with one's own hands. However, Ajisennin falls ill.
Summaries.jpn: 4枚の札を手にして味仙人の住む味わい寺を訪ねた陽一。味仙人は、料理の供養をしながらトーナメントに勝者の料理を待っていた。厨房に米しかないと知って驚く陽一だが、自らの手で材料を用意することの意味を知る。

Titles.eng: Taste Hunt! Marui vs. Mr. Ajikko
Titles.jpn: 味探し！丸井対ミスター味っ子

Summaries.eng: Marui has been invited by the Italian government, and he will be cooking for the celebration party himself. Yoichi tries to help, but is shocked when he tastes the sauce. Isn't Marui the one he really needs to overcome? And as a chef, Marui also wants to put an end to his relationship with Yoichi.
Summaries.jpn: 丸井がイタリア政府に招かれ、祝賀パーティーで丸井自身が腕を振るうことに。手伝おうとした陽一はソースを味見しただけで大きなショックを受ける。一方、丸井も料理人として陽一と区切りをつけたいと考えていた。

Titles.eng: Farewell Marui! The Path of Cooking Is An Endless Challenge
Titles.jpn: さらば丸井！料理の道は果てしなき挑戦

Summaries.eng: The time has come for Yoichi and Marui to face off in the "Taste Search" competition. However, Aji Shogun bursts into the venue and declares that Marui is a member of the Aji Shogun group, causing a stir in the venue. To clear Marui's name, Yoichi accepts the challenge from Shichibocho, but Aji Shogun's scheme puts both him and Marui in danger.
Summaries.jpn: 陽一と丸井の勝負「味探し」の時が来た。だが、会場に乱入した味将軍が丸井は味将軍グループの一員だと宣言し会場はどよめく。丸井の疑いを晴らそうと陽一は七包丁との勝負を受けるが、味将軍により追い込まれる。

Titles.eng: A Visitor From Hong Kong Tries the Legendary Chinese Soup!
Titles.jpn: 幻の中華スープに挑戦！香港からの訪問者

Summaries.eng: A man named Li Xiaogame comes to Hinode Shokudo from Hong Kong. Li, who was a good rival and close friend of Yoichi's father, Takao, says that his restaurant is being targeted by the Aji Shogun group, which is trying to extend its evil influence overseas. Yoichi stands up to Aji Shogun for his late father's best friend.
Summaries.jpn: 香港から来た李小亀と名乗る人物が、日之出食堂を訪れた。陽一の父・隆男の良きライバルであり親友だった李の店が、「海外にまで魔の手を伸ばそうとしている味将軍グループに狙われている」と李は言う。

Titles.eng: Challenge Yourself With This Legendary Chinese Soup! The Secret Of Cordyceps Sinensis
Titles.jpn: 幻の中華スープに挑戦！冬虫夏草の秘密

Summaries.eng: Aiming to perfect the legendary dish "Cordyceps Chicken Soup" written in his father's cooking notebook, Yoichi finally discovers the true nature of Cordyceps. However, the part about the chicken that will be used as an ingredient in the soup has been lost. What would be an ingredient that is both filling and nutritious and brings out the flavor of Cordyceps?
Summaries.jpn: 父が残した料理ノートに書かれた幻のメニュー「冬虫夏草鶏湯」の完成を目指す陽一は、ついに冬虫夏草の正体を突き止めた。しかし、スープの具となる鶏肉について記されていた部分は失われていた。

Titles.eng: Trying Steamed Dumplings! Going To Hong Kong
Titles.jpn: 蒸し餃子に挑戦！味っ子香港へ行く

Summaries.eng: Yoichi and his son, along with Koyama and his friends, have finally arrived in Hong Kong. They meet up with Mitsuko and Shigeru and visit Li Xiaogui's restaurant, Kogairo, where a young chef working there, Liu Hufeng, challenges Yoichi. Hufeng boasts that Japanese cuisine cannot compete with Chinese cuisine, which has a 4,000-year history, and the two engage in a steamed dumpling battle!
Summaries.jpn: 香港に来た陽一親子と甲山たちは、みつ子やしげると合流して李小亀の店「小亀楼」を訪れた。そこで働く少年料理人・劉虎峰が陽一に挑戦し、4千年の歴史を持つ中華料理に日本の料理がかなうわけがないと豪語する。

Titles.eng: Steamed Dumpling Showdown! Ajikko vs. Koho
Titles.jpn: 蒸し餃子決戦！味っ子対虎峰

Summaries.eng: While at a seafood market looking for fillings for their dumplings, Yoichi and his friends encounter Tonomine and Shigeru. While Tonomine is full of confidence, Yoichi finds a powerful ingredient - crab eggs - and begins the final filling. Yoichi's idea is to make dumplings with four ingredients: tomatoes, shiitake mushrooms, red chili peppers, and crab eggs.
Summaries.jpn: 餃子の具を探しに出かけた海鮮市場で、陽一たちは虎峰としげるに出会う。自信満々の虎峰に対し、陽一も強力な材料を見つけた。陽一のアイデアは、トマト、しいたけ、赤唐辛子、かにの卵の4種を具にした餃子だった。

Titles.eng: Ramen Battle! The Amazing 4,000-Year History of China
Titles.jpn: ラーメン勝負！驚くべき中国四千年の歴史

Summaries.eng: Toho promises to show Yoichi the wonder of China's 4,000-year history, and takes him to an island called Ryorinji Temple. The island is dedicated to culinary training. Toho shows off his skills by creating the legendary "Swallow Skin Noodles" from lean pork. He then challenges Yoichi to a ramen contest.
Summaries.jpn: 中華4千年の歴史のすごさを見せてやると言い、虎峰は陽一を「料林寺」という島に連れてきた。そこは全てが料理の修行のためにある島だった。虎峰は豚肉の赤身から幻の「燕皮麺」を作って力を見せつける。

Titles.eng: Ramen Showdown! White Soup vs. Black Soup
Titles.jpn: 決戦ラーメン勝負！白いスープ対黒いスープ

Summaries.eng: Yoichi believes that ramen soup should not only be made with meat and shellfish, and makes a milky white soup using the bones of the fish "ishimochi." However, he learns that Komine will use the "eel" he caught in the countryside as an ingredient. As Yoichi worries about what ingredient he should use, Ajio shows him the "Tiger in the Bamboo Forest."
Summaries.jpn: ラーメンのスープは肉や貝ばかりではないと、魚のイシモチの骨から取ったスープを作った陽一だが、虎峰が田園地帯で捕まえた田ウナギを具にすることを知る。自分の具は何を使えばいいかと悩む陽一だが…。

Titles.eng: Almond Tofu Competition! The Seven Chefs Of Taste Shogun Appear
Titles.jpn: 杏仁どうふ勝負！味将軍七包丁人登場

Summaries.eng: Kamon, who Toho studied under, is a member of the Aji Shogun group and the leading candidate for the position of Master of the 36 Boso at Ryorinji Temple. Yoichi and his friends are treated to a full Manchu Han banquet at Ryorinji Temple, but the final dessert is missing. Yoichi and Kamon are tasked with making it, and the item they'll be competing for is almond tofu!
Summaries.jpn: 虎峰が師事していたカモンは味将軍グループの1人で、料林寺三十六房総師範の筆頭候補。料林寺に乗り込んだ陽一たちに満漢全席が振る舞われるが、最後のデザートだけがない。それを作るのは陽一とカモンなのだった。

Titles.eng: Almond Tofu Competition! The Road to the 36th Room of Ryorinji Temple
Titles.jpn: 杏仁どうふ勝負！料林寺三十六房への道

Summaries.eng: Taking inspiration from marbles, they create almond tofu with rainbow-colored flower petals sealed inside. Yoichi struggles to decide on a container to put it in, but then comes up with the idea of ​​using watermelon, and Koho asks sculptor Yang Zizhong to create the container. Moved by the two's passion, Yang agrees to make the container. Beat the 36 chambers of Ryorinji Temple and challenge Kamon!
Summaries.jpn: ビー玉からヒントを得て七色の花びらを封じ込めた杏仁豆腐。陽一はそれを入れる器に悩むがスイカを使うことを思いつき、虎峰は彫刻家の楊子忠に器の作成を頼み込む。楊は2人の情熱に打たれ、器作りを引き受けた。

Titles.eng: Farewell Hong Kong, Protect the Ajioh Building!
Titles.jpn: 香港よさらば・味皇ビルを守り抜け！

Summaries.eng: As Yoichi returns to his home country, Koho gives him one of the Liu family's secret recipes as a souvenir. With the wonderful friend he met in Hong Kong in mind, Yoichi hurries to Ajioh upon arriving in Japan, only to find that half of the Ajioh building has been demolished. The Ajishogun Group's Hong Kong landing operation was a diversionary tactic to lure Ajioh away from Japan!
Summaries.jpn: 帰国する陽一は、虎峰から別れ際に劉家秘伝のひとつを土産にもらった。香港での素晴らしい友との出会いを胸に日本に到着すると、陽一はすぐに味皇のもとへ向かうが、何と味皇ビルは半分取り壊されていた。

Titles.eng: Gyoza Battle: A Big Turnaround! The Ambition of Aji Shogun
Titles.jpn: 餃子勝負・大逆転！味将軍の野望

Summaries.eng: In order to protect the Ajioh Building, which is about to be demolished, Yoichi and the Donburi brothers challenge three of the candidates for the Seven Ajishogun chefs to a gyoza competition. Yoichi has no time to think of new ideas, so he struggles to make the gyoza he has made so far. At that moment, Yoichi remembers the souvenir from Koho.
Summaries.jpn: 今にも取り壊されようとしている味皇ビルを守るため、陽一と丼兄弟は味将軍七包丁人候補3人との餃子勝負に挑む。新しいアイデアを考える時間がない陽一は、これまでに作った餃子を作るが苦戦を強いられる。

Titles.eng: New Year's Eve Soba Delivery Battle! The Battle At Inari Shopping Street
Titles.jpn: 年越しそば出前合戦！いなり商店街の攻防

Summaries.eng: On the day of the winter solstice, a queue of customers formed at Muramasa-an, a restaurant run by Takechi Muramasa, one of the Seven Aji Shogun chefs, hoping to get a taste of the delicious and affordable soba noodles. In order to eliminate the stores and shopping districts that are not members of the Aji Shogun group, Takechi first challenges Kin-san of Kin Soba to a taste contest. With the number of customers declining, Yoichi asks Kin-san to help out as he pulls his food stall.
Summaries.jpn: 冬至の日。味将軍七包丁の1人である武智村正の店「村正庵」では、おいしくて安い蕎麦を目当てに行列ができていた。武智は味将軍グループに加盟しない店や商店街を潰すため、まずは金蕎麦の金さんに味勝負を挑む。

Titles.eng: New Year's Eve Soba Delivery Battle! The Mysterious Hero Ajitoukan Appears
Titles.jpn: 年越しそば出前合戦！謎の快傑味頭巾見参

Summaries.eng: Yoichi's soba noodles are made with tofu as a binder and green buckwheat flowers. Motivated by the Aji Shogun Shopping Center's offensive, the people of the shopping district offer to help Yoichi and Kane-san with their delivery, but the essential soup is not ready. While brainstorming ideas at a coffee shop, Yoichi comes up with an idea when he sees someone making coffee.
Summaries.jpn: つなぎに豆腐を使い、青そばの花を入れた陽一の蕎麦が完成。味将軍ショッピングセンターの攻勢に奮起した商店街の人々が、陽一と金さんに出前を手伝うと申し出るが、肝心のつゆがまだできていなかった。

Titles.eng: Kanazawa Nigiri Sushi Contest! Genesushi Daitora's Challenge
Titles.jpn: 金沢にぎり寿司コンテスト！ジェネスシ大虎の挑戦

Summaries.eng: Yoichi, Ajiou, and the others visit Sushigen, a sushi restaurant in Kanazawa owned by Noriko's brother, Genichi. According to his brother's wife, Yoshiko, six sushi restaurants in the town compete in a sushi contest every year, but last year Sushigen came in last, which has left Genichi feeling disheartened. Yoshiko asks Yoichi for help, but...
Summaries.jpn: 金沢に来た陽一と味皇たち一行は、法子の兄・源一の寿司屋「寿司源」を訪れる。兄嫁の良子は、この街の6軒の寿司屋は毎年コンテストで味を競うも寿司源は昨年最下位で、源一はすっかり弱気になってしまったと言う。

Titles.eng: Kanazawa Nigiri Sushi Contest! Big Win With Creative Sushi Toppings
Titles.jpn: 金沢にぎり寿司コンテスト！寿司ネタの工夫で大勝利

Summaries.eng: This year's contest features Gene Sushi, home to God Hand Ohtora, one of the Seven Chefs of Aji Shogun. Ohtora buys up all the fatty tuna and seaweed. Each sushi restaurant has no choice but to participate in the contest with sushi that has neither fatty tuna nor seaweed. Will Yoichi's ingenious sushi please the judges?
Summaries.jpn: 今回のコンテストには味将軍七包丁人の1人であるゴッドハンド・大虎がいるジェネスシが加わり、大虎は大トロと海苔を買い占めてしまった。各寿司店は、トロも海苔もない寿司でコンテストに参加するしかない。

Titles.eng: Snow Festival Frankfurt Showdown! The Devil Of The North Appears
Titles.jpn: 雪祭りフランクフルト勝負！北の悪魔現わる

Summaries.eng: While watching the live broadcast of the Snow Festival, Yoichi and Ajio spot Sekiba, the head of the German cuisine department of the Ajio Culinary Association, who has gone missing, and head to Hokkaido to find out if it's true. At the Snow Festival, there was a long line of people waiting for the food stall run by the "Devil of the North." The Devil of the North's frankfurters were made by Sekiba.
Summaries.jpn: 雪まつりの中継を見ていた陽一と味皇は、行方不明の味皇料理会ドイツ料理部主任・関場の姿を見つけ、真偽を確かめるため北海道へ行く。雪まつり会場では、「北の悪魔」率いる屋台にだけ長蛇の列ができていた。

Titles.eng: Snow Festival Frankfurt Match! Showdown With Sekiba
Titles.jpn: 雪祭りフランクフルト勝負！関場との対決

Summaries.eng: Yoichi accepts the challenge of making frankfurters from Sekiba, and he thinks of a way to make them warm from the inside out, so that people who eat them can survive the cold of Hokkaido. Meanwhile, Sekiba, who is eagerly waiting for his final chance to challenge Yoichi, receives a certain item. And so, the taste contest between Yoichi and Sekiba finally begins!
Summaries.jpn: 関場とのフランクフルト勝負を受けた陽一は、寒い北海道で食べた人がずっと身体の芯から暖まる工夫を考える。その頃、陽一との勝負を最後のチャンスと待ち望んでいた関場のもとに、ある品物が届いていた。

Titles.eng: Alex Express Gourmet Incident! RoboCook's Second Challenge
Titles.jpn: アレックス急行グルメ事件！ロボコックの再挑戦

Summaries.eng: Yoichi and his friends board the gourmet train Royal Alex at the invitation of Sanshiro Tawara. As they head from Sapporo to Ueno, Robo Chef, one of the Seven Chefs, appears. Under orders from Taste Shogun, Robo Chef challenges Yoichi and Tawara's cooking machine, Alex No. 2, to a full-course meal challenge in order to conquer the gourmet train.
Summaries.jpn: 陽一たちは俵三四郎に招かれグルメ列車・ロイヤルアレックス号に乗車。札幌から上野に向かうその車中に七包丁の1人・ロボコックが現れ、列車攻略のため陽一と俵の料理マシーン「アレックス2号」に勝負を挑む。

Titles.eng: Alex Express Gourmet Incident! Aim For The Goal With Dessert
Titles.jpn: アレックス急行グルメ事件！デザートでゴールをめざせ

Summaries.eng: The showdown with RoboCook remains two against two, and they decide to have a rematch over dessert the next morning. While the trains are stopped due to heavy snowfall, Yoichi goes out to look for ingredients. He visits a shrine with an old woman he helped in town, and there he is inspired by a new idea.
Summaries.jpn: ロボコックとの対決は2対2のまま、翌朝デザートでの再勝負となった。豪雪により列車が止まった間に陽一は材料を探しに出かける。そして町で助けた老婆と一緒に神社に参拝した陽一は、そこである工夫をひらめいた。

Titles.eng: Island-Hopping Seaweed Hotpot Competition! Seven Chefs Master Oishi Appears
Titles.jpn: 島巡り磯鍋競争！七包丁人大石老師登場

Summaries.eng: Master Oishi, one of the Seven Knives and instructor of the Setouchi Young Chefs, receives an order from Aji Shogun to defeat Yoichi. Due to his advanced age, Oishi tries to refuse, but his student Yuta unilaterally lures Ajio and Yoichi. When Yoichi heads to the Setouchi Islands, he is met with an island-hopping seaweed hotpot competition with the Setouchi Young Chefs.
Summaries.jpn: 七包丁の1人で瀬戸内少年料理団を指導する大石老師に、味将軍から打倒陽一の指令書が届く。大石は高齢ゆえに断ろうとするが、教え子のユウタが独断で味皇と陽一をおびき寄せる。そして陽一は瀬戸内へ向かうが…。

Titles.eng: Island-Hopping Iso Nabe Competition! The Setouchi Youth Cooking Group Takes On The Challenge
Titles.jpn: 島巡り磯鍋競争！瀬戸内少年料理団の挑戦

Summaries.eng: Yoichi and his friends and the Setouchi Boys' Cooking Club begin a five-on-five island-hopping sea stew competition. Yuta and the other five, all born and raised on the Setouchi coast, gather fresh ingredients one after another. Yoichi and his friends are unable to gather the ingredients properly due to their lack of geographical advantage, and even end up dropping the pot and seasonings into the sea. What is Yoichi's idea for a pot and a pot without seasonings?
Summaries.jpn: 陽一たちと瀬戸内少年料理団、5人対5人の島巡り磯鍋勝負が始まる。瀬戸内の海で生まれ育ったユウタたち5人は次々と新鮮な材料を集める。地の利のない陽一たちはうまく材料を集められず、さらなる窮地に立たされる。

Titles.eng: A Relentless Hamburger Battle! Abe And Oikawa Are Unrepentant
Titles.jpn: 執念のハンバーガー勝負！懲りない阿部と及川

Summaries.eng: Ajiou collapses. Despite everyone's concerns, Ajiou says he is only slightly anemic, but Tarume asks him to recover quickly and return to the Ajiou Building. Meanwhile, Ajishogun decides to summon Abe Ichiro, the leader of the Seven Chefs. Upon hearing this, Abe Jiro, not wanting to lose to his brother, challenges his partner Oikawa to a desperate taste contest.
Summaries.jpn: 倒れてしまった味皇。みんなの心配をよそに味皇は軽い貧血だと言うが、垂目は早く療養して味皇ビルに戻ってほしいと頼んだ。その頃、味将軍は七包丁人のリーダー・阿部一郎を呼び寄せることを決意する。

Titles.eng: Hamburger Showdown! The Strongest Of The Seven Knives, Ichiro Abe, Appears
Titles.jpn: 対決ハンバーガー勝負！最強の七包丁・阿部一郎登場

Summaries.eng: Yoichi and Yoshimura accept the hamburger taste contest, and after much ingenuity, starting with the making of the bun, they finally create a Yoichi-style hamburger. It's so good that Ajiou, who is hospitalized, becomes energized after tasting it. Ajiou tries to get Yukari, a girl in the same hospital room, to try Yoichi's hamburger, but she refuses.
Summaries.jpn: ハンバーガー味勝負を受けた陽一と吉村は、陽一流ハンバーガーを完成させた。試食した入院中の味皇が元気になるほどの出来栄えで、味皇は同じ病室の少女・ゆかりにも陽一のハンバーガーを食べてもらおうとするが…。

Titles.eng: A Tough Hamburger Contest! A Letter From Uncle Long Legs
Titles.jpn: 苦戦ハンバーガー勝負！足長おじさんからの手紙

Summaries.eng: Yoichi eats Ichiro Abe's hamburger, but is so impressed by how delicious it is that he loses all confidence. Meanwhile, Ajiou receives news from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs that they will be competing in a three-on-three sukiyaki contest with the Ajishogun Group at a state dinner for King Kobaia. Yoichi, Kazuma, and Konishi are set to participate, but...
Summaries.jpn: 阿部一郎のハンバーガーを食べた陽一は、あまりのうまさに自信を無くしてしまった。そんな時、味皇のもとに外務省から、国賓のコバイア国王の晩餐会で味将軍グループと3対3のスキヤキ勝負を行うという知らせが届く。

Titles.eng: Japan's Best Sukiyaki Competition! Find The Taste Of Your Memories
Titles.jpn: 日本一のスキヤキ勝負！思い出の味を探せ

Summaries.eng: The Aji Shogun turns out to be none other than Ajio's younger brother, Murata Genzaburou. Shortly after Japan's defeat in the war, the three brothers, who safely returned home with their eldest brother, Genichiro, vowed to rebuild Murata Shokudo. However, with Genichiro's death, the two brothers parted ways, each pursuing their own path in cooking. What will be the outcome of the final taste battle between Ajio and Aji Shogun?
Summaries.jpn: 味将軍は何と味皇の弟・村田源三郎だった。敗戦直後、長兄・源一郎と無事復員した三兄弟は、村田食堂を再建しようと誓いあうが、源一郎の死により袂を分かった2人はそれぞれ料理に求める道を歩んだのだった。

Titles.eng: Sukiyaki Showdown! The Seven Strongest Knives vs. Mr. Ajikko
Titles.jpn: スキヤキ決戦！最強の七包丁対ミスター味っ子

Summaries.eng: The day of the sukiyaki competition finally arrives. Yoichi is astounded by Ichiro Abe's skill in preparing the finest Matsusaka beef like a doctor, and once again loses confidence. However, with the support of his fellow competitors, and Mitsuko's encouragement and gift of a handmade apron, Yoichi regains his composure and begins cooking.
Summaries.jpn: スキヤキ勝負の日。最高級の松阪牛をまるで医師のように調理する阿部一郎に脅威を感じ、再び自信を喪失する陽一。だが、味勝負を戦った仲間からの応援やみつ子の励まし、手作りエプロンのプレゼントにより復活する。

Titles.eng: Koyasan Tofu Battle! A Journey Of 3,000 Miles To Visit The King of Taste
Titles.jpn: 高野山・豆腐勝負！味皇訪ねて三千里

Summaries.eng: One day, after the battle with the Aji Shogun group had come to an end, Sakai Kazuma transferred to Yoichi's class. He opened a curry restaurant called "Ichimaya" in front of Hinode Shokudo, and is determined to take on the challenge at his restaurant. The next day, Ajio was nowhere to be seen at the traditional cherry blossom viewing party. It was only after Yoichi was gone that he realized how important Ajio was.
Summaries.jpn: 味将軍グループとの戦いも終わったある日、陽一のクラスに堺一馬が転校してきた。日之出食堂の前にカレー専門店「一馬屋」をオープンし、今度は店で勝負すると息巻く。翌日、恒例の花見の宴に味皇の姿はなかった。

Titles.eng: Mysterious Taste King Grand Prix: Trying Out Tofu Dishes!
Titles.jpn: 謎の味皇グランプリ 豆腐料理に挑戦！

Summaries.eng: Yoichi and Kazuma are fed "sesame tofu," a traditional Mount Koya dish, by Okara and Kanpei of Daimonya. Just as they are blown away by its deliciousness, Kinuko, the daughter of a tofu shop called Hijiriya, appears before them. Kinuko asks the two to take part in the Ajioh Grand Prix in place of her sick father.
Summaries.jpn: 陽一と一馬が大門屋のおからと勘平夫妻に食べさせられたのは、高野山伝統の味「ゴマ豆腐」だった。そのあまりのおいしさに打ちのめされた2人の前に、ひじり屋という豆腐屋の娘である絹子が現れた。

Titles.eng: The Big Showdown At Mount Koya! Tofu Steak vs. Sesame tofu
Titles.jpn: 高野山で大決戦！豆腐ステーキ対ゴマ豆腐

Summaries.eng: Yoichi's completed tofu steak had a flaw. The Daimonya couple made fun of his imperfect tofu steak, which made Yoichi and Kazuma anxious, but they overcame the flaw with their ingenuity. On the day of the Ajiou Grand Prix, the competition began while the other tofu makers withdrew. Will tofu steak or sesame tofu win?
Summaries.jpn: 完成した陽一の豆腐ステーキには欠点があった。大門屋夫婦に不完全な豆腐ステーキをばかにされ焦る陽一と一馬だが、2人の工夫で欠点を克服した。味皇グランプリ当日、ほかの豆腐屋が棄権をするなか、勝負が始まる。

Titles.eng: Chimaki And Kashiwamochi Competition! The Challenge Of The 2nd Year Flower Class Cooking Team
Titles.jpn: ちまき・柏もち勝負！2年花組料理隊の挑戦

Summaries.eng: Ms. Egawa accepts the challenge of the unexpected appearance of the "2nd Year Flower Class Cooking Team" and decides to compete in a Children's Day contest using rice dumplings and kashiwamochi. Yoichi learns that the cooks are the daughters of the former Seven Chefs of the Aji Shogun Group, and agrees to help Ms. Egawa. He also asks Kazuma for help, but he refuses, saying that he hates Children's Day.
Summaries.jpn: 突然現れた「2年花組料理隊」の挑戦を受け、江川女史が子供の日にちまきと柏餅で勝負をすることになった。陽一は、料理隊が元味将軍グループ七包丁人たちの娘であることを知り、江川女史に協力する。

Titles.eng: Chimaki vs Kashiwamochi Showdown! Taste Comparison On May 5th
Titles.jpn: ちまき・柏もち決戦！5月5日の味くらべ

Summaries.eng: Children's Day is finally here. However, Kazuma's whereabouts are unknown after the chefs criticize the kashiwamochi he made, and his chimaki (rice dumpling) recipe still lacks a winning formula. Then, upon seeing a cake sent by Marui, he comes up with an innovative idea. Kazuma, who has been watching from the shadows, sees the flaws in Yoichi's idea.
Summaries.jpn: いよいよ子供の日を迎えた。しかし、作った柏餅を料理隊にけなされた一馬の行方はわからず、ちまきの工夫も決め手に欠けたまま。そんな時、丸井からの差し入れのケーキを見て、陽一はある工夫を思いつくが…。

Titles.eng: A Stormy Curry Battle! Kamon And Mori's Counterattack
Titles.jpn: 嵐を呼ぶカレー勝負！カモンと毛利の大逆襲

Summaries.eng: Yoichi receives a letter from Aji Shogun. He says that Ajioh has formed a group called the Ajioh Culinary Alliance in Matsumoto City and is up to no good. To find out the truth, Yoichi and Kazuma head to Matsumoto City. While most of the city is under the control of the Ajioh Culinary Alliance, they meet Ryoko, the daughter of an inn owner who refuses to join the alliance.
Summaries.jpn: 味皇が松本市で味皇料理同盟なる集団を作って悪どいことをやっていると聞き、真相を確かめるため現地に赴く陽一と一馬。市内の大半が味皇料理同盟に支配されるなか、同盟への加入を拒む旅館の娘・亮子と知りあう。

Titles.eng: Yoichi And Kazuma Are In Big Trouble! A Big Comeback With German-style Curry
Titles.jpn: 陽一・一馬危機一発！ドイツ風カレーで大逆転

Summaries.eng: With Yoichi's saffron rice and Kazuma's new special blend curry, they finally complete a new curry to compete with Kamon and Mori. However, just before the match, Kamon and Mori add a condition that their winning dish must incorporate a dish from another country into their curry.
Summaries.jpn: 陽一のサフランライスと一馬のニュースペシャルブレンドカレーにより、カモンと毛利に対抗する新しいカレーがついに完成。だが、カモンと毛利は、勝負品目をカレーに別の国の料理を加えるという条件を出す。

Titles.eng: Aji No Matasaburo Takes On The Challenge Of Making Udon Noodles That Never Get Cold!
Titles.jpn: 冷めないうどんに挑戦！味の又三郎登場

Summaries.eng: On their way home from school, Yoichi and his friends are approached by a traveling chef named Matasaburo. The next day, Matasaburo transfers to Yoichi's school and explains that he is a disciple of Ajio and has come to compete against Yoichi. The item to be competed in is a udon delivery contest, with the students having to deliver the noodles from the school cafeteria to the president's office.
Summaries.jpn: 陽一たちの学校に転校してきた又三郎は流しの料理人で、自分は味皇の弟子であり、陽一と対決するためにやってきたのだと言う。そして勝負品目は、学食から学長室まで運ぶ、うどん出前競争に決まった。

Titles.eng: School Delivery Competition! Special Udon Noodles Win Big
Titles.jpn: 学園出前競争！特製うどんで大勝利

Summaries.eng: Yoichi struggles to come up with a way to make udon that stays warm. Kazuma calls Matasaburo to the rooftop to find out his true identity, but is brushed off. At that moment, Kazuma finds a photo that Matasaburo had dropped. On the day of the competition, Yoichi gets a hint about the udon from Mitsuko and clashes with Matasaburo.
Summaries.jpn: 陽一は冷めないうどんの工夫に苦戦する。又三郎の正体を確かめようとする一馬は、又三郎の落とした一枚の写真を手に入れた。迎えた勝負の日、みつ子からうどんのヒントをもらった陽一は、又三郎と激突する。

Titles.eng: The Original Croquette Battle! Tarume’s Love Story
Titles.jpn: 元祖コロッケ合戦！垂目の恋物語

Summaries.eng: Yoichi and his friends are invited to Tarume's engagement party. Tarume and his fiancée, Shirakawa Rie, are from a Yokohama croquette shop that has been fighting for generations over which family is the original, but their marriage has led to a reconciliation between the two families. However, on the day of the party, the conflict between the two families flares up again, and they decide to have a taste test to decide which family is the original.
Summaries.jpn: 陽一たちは垂目の婚約パーティに招待された。垂目と婚約者の白川理恵の家は、代々どちらが本家かを争っている横浜のコロッケ屋だが、2人の結婚をきっかけに両家とも仲直りすることになったという。

Titles.eng: The Original Croquette Battle! A Taste Contest On A Luxury Cruise Ship
Titles.jpn: 元祖コロッケ合戦！豪華客船で味勝負

Summaries.eng: A croquette competition between Tarume and Yoichi versus Rie and Kazuma. Kazuma is confident in his croquette creations, but Rie warns him not to underestimate Tarume. However, Tarume and Yoichi struggle to make the croquettes. Meanwhile, Tarume, having regained his energy after confirming his love for Rie, comes up with a clever idea.
Summaries.jpn: 垂目・陽一対理恵・一馬のコロッケ勝負が決まった。コロッケの工夫に関して自信満々の一馬だが、理恵は垂目のことを侮ってはいけないと言う。しかし、垂目と陽一はコロッケ作りに悪戦苦闘していた。

Titles.eng: Yakitori Competition! Trying Out The Taste Of A Long-Established Restaurant
Titles.jpn: ヤキトリで勝負！老舗の味に挑戦だ

Summaries.eng: Fuyuhiko, the owner of Torifune, a long-established yakitori restaurant in the neighboring town, has two sons: Akihiko, who travels around Japan, and Natsuhiko, who trains at the restaurant. Fuyuhiko trusted Natsuhiko more than Akihiko, but Natsuhiko suddenly told Fuyuhiko he was retiring. Akihiko scolds his younger brother for being selfish, but Natsuhiko challenges him to a taste contest.
Summaries.jpn: となり町にある老舗の焼き鳥屋「鳥舟」の主人・冬彦には、日本中を放浪する長男・秋彦と、店で修行に打ち込む次男・夏彦がいた。秋彦より夏彦に信頼を寄せていた冬彦だったが、夏彦は父に突然引退を告げた。

Titles.eng: Yakitori Drumming Battle! A Big Victory With Creative Sauce
Titles.jpn: ヤキトリ太鼓合戦！タレの工夫で大勝利

Summaries.eng: The day of the yakitori competition approaches, but the problem of the sauce has not been solved and Akihiko is still missing. Yoichi and the others suspect that Akihiko has really run away, but Noriko says that no child would abandon their father and that she will believe in Akihiko. Then, on the day of the yakitori drumming battle, Akihiko returns just before the competition begins.
Summaries.jpn: 焼き鳥勝負の日が近づくが、タレの工夫は解決できず、秋彦の行方も不明のままだった。陽一たちは秋彦が本当に逃げたのではと疑うが、法子は「自分の父親を見捨てる子供はいない、秋彦を信じよう」と言う。

Titles.eng: An Afternoon At Hinode Shokudo: Find The Missing Curtain!
Titles.jpn: 日之出食堂の午後 消えたのれんを捜しだせ！

Summaries.eng: One day at Hinode Diner, the noren curtain has disappeared due to Noriko's carelessness. Yoichi wants to buy a new one, but Marui and Noriko explain the importance of noren curtains. Yoichi goes looking for the noren curtain, which is also a memento of Takao for Noriko. Meanwhile, at Kazuma's stable, the cricket that Kazuma scolded has disappeared.
Summaries.jpn: 法子の不注意から日之出食堂ののれんが無くなってしまった。この際新調しようという陽一に、丸井と法子はのれんの大切さを説く。陽一は、法子にとって隆男との思い出の品でもあるのれんを探しにいく。

Titles.eng: Ice Cream Showdown! Mitsuko And The Cricket Challenge
Titles.jpn: アイスクリームで対決！みつ子とコオロギの挑戦

Summaries.eng: After eating the food Yoichi had cooked, the old man Takizawa noticed that the knife had become dull, and left, telling Yoichi to come to Izu if he wanted it sharpened. When Yoichi and the others arrived in Izu, they were reunited with Shokichi. Takizawa said that he would only let them see the sharpness of the knife in their hearts without using it, as a condition for sharpening the knife.
Summaries.jpn: 陽一の作った料理を食べ、包丁に問題があると見抜いた滝沢老人は、「包丁を研いでほしくば伊豆へ来い」と告げて去った。陽一らは伊豆に行き、「包丁を使わず、心の包丁の切れ味を見せてほしい」と滝沢に言われる。

Titles.eng: Ice Cream Showdown! A Midsummer Night Taste Contest
Titles.jpn: アイスクリームで対決！真夏の夜の味勝負

Summaries.eng: Shokichi looks down on Yoichi and Kazuma, who say ice cream isn't cooking and underestimate Mitsuko and Koorogi. On the night before the competition, Mitsuko and Koorogi lose even more confidence after watching the three cook off, but Shokichi gives them encouragement. The two bravely take on the summer ice cream competition as a test of courage.
Summaries.jpn: アイスは料理じゃないと言い、みつ子とコオロギのこともなめてかかる陽一と一馬に、章吉は厳しい目を向けた。勝負前夜、3人の料理合戦を見てさらに自信を失うみつ子とコオロギに、章吉は心強い応援をする。

Titles.eng: Onigiri Competition! Japan's Most Irresponsible Cook Appears
Titles.jpn: オニギリ勝負！日本一の無責任料理男登場

Summaries.eng: Hearing from Takizawa that Ajio will be returning, Yoichi and his friends head to Tokyo. There, they are greeted and shown around by Wekki Hitoshi, who claims to know Ajio's whereabouts, but the shops in the area are run by men who look just like Ajio. While searching to question Wekki, the group becomes hungry and enters a rice ball shop called "Tomiya."
Summaries.jpn: 味皇が帰ってくると滝沢から聞いた陽一たちは東京に向かい、そこで味皇の居場所を知っていると言うウエッキーひとしに迎えられ案内される。すると、一帯の店は彼と同じ顔をした男たちが経営していた。

Titles.eng: Onigiri Showdown! Irresponsible Cooking vs. Mom's Taste
Titles.jpn: オニギリ決戦！無責任料理対おふくろの味

Summaries.eng: Otomi and Yoichi from Tomiya challenge Hitoshi Wekki to a rice ball contest with heartfelt simplicity. After Yoichi and his friends win, Wekki and his friends run away, but Marui rushes in and tells them to hurry to the Ajioh Building. At the Ajioh Building, Yoichi and his friends are greeted by a haggard Ajishogun.
Summaries.jpn: 味っ子ファミリーは、ウエッキーひとしとのおにぎり勝負に心のこもったシンプルさで挑む。味っ子ファミリーが勝利し、ウエッキーたちは逃げていくが、そこへ丸井が駆けつけ「急いで味皇ビルに来るように」と言う。

Titles.eng: A Desperate Cooking Battle Of Three! Ichiro Abe's Second Attempt
Titles.jpn: 決死の料理三番勝負！阿部一郎の再挑戦

Summaries.eng: Yoichi and Kazuma head to Aji Shogun's castle after receiving a call from Aji Oh. They are greeted by Mori and guided to the King's Chamber, where they are confronted by Dr. Chef Abe Ichiro, who was defeated by Yoichi and his friends in the sukiyaki contest. Abe demands that they take part in a three-match taste contest if they don't want their irresponsible cooking to be spread all over the country.
Summaries.jpn: 味皇からの電話を受け、陽一と一馬は味将軍の城へ向かった。出迎えた毛利に案内されて王の間にやってきた2人の前に現れたのは、スキヤキ勝負で陽一たちに敗れたドクターシェフ・阿部一郎だった。

Titles.eng: Ajikko's Final Battle! The Biggest Sandwich Battle In History
Titles.jpn: 味っ子最後の戦い！史上最大のサンドイッチ勝負

Summaries.eng: The sandwich competition with Abe Ichiro begins. Abe says that cooking is something you make alone, but Yoichi and the others explain that cooking should really be about thinking about the people who will eat it. Abe explains that this is the result of such thinking, and introduces Ajiou to the two. It turns out that Ajiou has lost his memory in his pursuit of flavor.
Summaries.jpn: 阿部一郎とのサンドイッチ勝負が始まった。料理は1人で作るものだと言う阿部に対し、陽一たちは料理は食べる人のことを考えるのが本当だと説くが、「そんな考えの結果がこうだ」と阿部は2人を味皇に会わせる。

Titles.eng: Let The Chef's Poem Resound And Restore Ajiou's Memories!
Titles.jpn: 響け料理人の詩・味皇の記憶を取り戻せ！

Summaries.eng: Ajiou returns to the cooking club, but his memories still haven't returned. Yoichi is puzzled to see Kazuma relying on Ajiou. Just then, the cooking club's leaders, Konishi Kazuya, Ajifune Toshiya, and others arrive. They say they will feed Ajiou their food and help him regain his memories.
Summaries.jpn: 料理会に帰還したものの、味皇の記憶は依然として戻らなかった。そんな味皇に甘える一馬の姿を陽一は不審に思う。そこへ料理会の主任たちと小西和也、味船敏八が、味皇の記憶を取り戻させるべくやってきた。

Titles.eng: Kazuma's Secret Is Revealed! Pilgrimage Of The Taste of Sadness
Titles.jpn: 明かされた一馬の秘密！悲しみの味遍路

Summaries.eng: After learning Ajitokin's true identity, Kazuma locks himself in the store and refuses to come out. Yoichi and his friends are worried, but President Nagata comes to see them. Nagata asks Ajio to somehow help him regain his memories and begins to tell them about Kazuma's shocking past.
Summaries.jpn: 味頭巾の正体を知ってしまった一馬は、店に閉じこもったまま出てこない。心配する陽一たちの所に永田社長がやってきて、何とか味皇の記憶を取り戻してくれと頼み、一馬の驚くべき過去を語り始める。

Titles.eng: The Long Journey To A Taste: A Lonely Search For Flavor
Titles.jpn: 遥かなる味への道・ひとりぼっちの味探し

Summaries.eng: Even the heads of the cooking club and Kazuma are unable to restore Ajiou's memories. Yoichi feeds him a katsudon, which he poured all his energy into, but his memories do not return. Yoichi is hopeful that Marui will now be his turn, but is shocked when Noriko tells him about Marui's proposal.
Summaries.jpn: 料理会の主任たちや一馬でさえも、味皇の記憶を蘇らせることができない。陽一は全精力を注ぎ込んだカツ丼を食べさせるが、その記憶は戻らなかった。今度は自分の番だと言う丸井に陽一は期待するが…。

Titles.eng: Thank You For The Meal! Mr. Ajikko
Titles.jpn: ごちそうさま！ミスター味っ子

Summaries.eng: Shigeru gets into a traffic accident while trying to pick up a ticket that was blown away by the wind. He is not seriously injured, but Yoichi is tormented by the belief that the accident was his own fault. When Shigeru regains consciousness, he is delighted with the delicious omelet that Mitsuko has made. Mitsuko's omelet, Noriko's words, and the Kabuyama couple's dinner table. Realizing something important, Yoichi makes katsudon for Ajiou again.
Summaries.jpn: 風に飛ばされたチケットを拾おうとして、しげるは交通事故に遭ってしまった。命に別状はなかったが、陽一は自分の責任だと苦悩する。やがてしげるの意識は戻り、みつ子が作った卵焼きをおいしいと喜ぶ。
